cohort: 22 UAP cases treated at a single institution over a 6-year period
finding: Uterine artery pseudoaneurysm (UAP) may not be as rare as previously thought, and it can occur after non-traumatic deliveries or pregnancy terminations and without significant hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Uterine artery pseudoaneurysm (UAP) was observed in patients after both traumatic and non-traumatic deliveries or pregnancy terminations.
